# Test-data provenance

`input.edf` contains the first 60 seconds of subject S002 in DREAMT v2.1.0.
It uses the published ECG, BVP, THORAX, and ABDOMEN columns, resampled from
100 Hz to the family rate of 200 Hz. DREAMT is described by DOI
`10.13026/7r9r-7r24` and uses the PhysioNet Restricted Health Data License 1.5.0.
The derived EDF has SHA-256
`d892afb9fe89914d3a940f36c33c991e81be32ff6b63e11478c7ffb4e1af10c0`.

This derivative must be reviewed under the project-wide data-use policy before
MedOmni becomes public. It is included now under the collaborator decision to
record unresolved license status without blocking encoder work.
